title: Sorbaria sorbifolia flavonoid derivative induces mitochondrial apoptosis in human hepatoma cells through Bclaf1.
authors: Chen, Jiaxin; Cheng, Haoyi; Bai, Chunhua; Wang, Dandan; Fu, Jinghao; Hao, Jinge; Wang, Yixuan; Xuewu, Zhang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮衍生物通过Bclaf1诱导肝癌细胞线粒体凋亡，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: 4',5,7-Trihydroxy-8-methoxyflavone is an anticancer monomer component isolated from the traditional Chinese medicine Sorbaria sorbifolia. 4',5-Dihydroxy-7-piperazinemethoxy-8-methoxy flavonoids (DMF) with good solubility and anti-tumor effects was obtained by chemical modification in the early stage. This study explored the mechanism by which DMF regulates the mitochondrial apoptosis of human hepatoma cells through Bcl-2-associated transcription factor 1 (Bclaf1). DMF inhibited the proliferation of human hepatoma cells in a concentration- and time-dependent manner and induced cell mitochondrial apoptosis. The molecular docking and cell assay results demonstrated that DMF inhibits Bclaf1 expression by binding to its active site. Lentivirus transfection was used to construct cells with stable knockout and overexpression of Bclaf1, and a Hep3B xenograft model was constructed in nude mice. The mechanism by which DMF induced the mitochondrial apoptosis of human hepatoma cells through Bclaf1 was further verified in vitro and in vivo. These findings indicated that DMF induced human hepatoma cell mitochondrial apoptosis through Bclaf1.
abstract_zh: 4',5,7-三羟基-8-甲氧基黄酮是从传统中药珍珠梅（Sorbaria sorbifolia）中分离得到的抗癌单体成分。前期通过化学修饰获得了溶解性好且具有抗肿瘤作用的4',5-二羟基-7-哌嗪甲氧基-8-甲氧基黄酮（DMF）。本研究探讨了DMF通过Bcl-2相关转录因子1（Bclaf1）调控人肝癌细胞线粒体凋亡的机制。DMF以浓度和时间依赖性方式抑制人肝癌细胞增殖，并诱导细胞线粒体凋亡。分子对接和细胞实验结果表明，DMF通过结合Bclaf1的活性位点抑制其表达。利用慢病毒转染构建了Bclaf1稳定敲除和过表达的细胞，并在裸鼠中构建了Hep3B异种移植模型。通过体外和体内实验进一步验证了DMF通过Bclaf1诱导人肝癌细胞线粒体凋亡的机制。这些发现表明，DMF通过Bclaf1诱导人肝癌细胞线粒体凋亡。
